_comment: CLAUDE.md rule 3. Scopes are '<file>' or '<file>#<label>' (the \section/\subsection block carrying that \label). 'forbid' lists data_source values that may not be cited (via a numbers.tex macro) inside the scope; 'require' restricts to the listed values. Main-text files listed under main_text may not cite simulator macros anywhere except in the scopes listed under simulator_allowed.

paper/sections/05_nuisance.tex.why: nuisance theorem validated on real / semi-synthetic data only

paper/sections/08_experiments.tex#sec:me.why: clinical section (T1, MIMIC-IV-ECG x ECHO): real data only
